item.title: EASY BAKED CHICKEN TACOS | HIGH PROTEIN RECIPES
item.description: BAKED CHICKEN TACOS RECIPE BY amy.darley 1. Throw 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts in you crockpot and top with 2 packets of taco seasoning, 28oz can of rotel, and a small can of green chilies. Cook on low for 4 hours. 2. Shred your chicken. 3. Add stand and stuff taco shells to a baking dish. Stuff the shells with your chicken mixture and top with shredded cheese (I used pepper jack and Colby jack).
